body.x: Intel is rapidly developing its wearable devices. It reported that it is developing wearables to enhance athletes’ skills along with Oakley. It is planning to launch them this year.Furthermore, the company is also working in collaboration with New Balance, a sports brand. On that day, the CEO of New Balance and CEO Krzanich came on stage, wearing running shoes with the 3D insoles made by using Intel RealSense technology. They announced that they are developing a sports watch together.At this exhibition, Intel introduced a wearable device that is similar to actual clothing. Users can actually wear the device like clothing.
